[[File:Marcan_herb_LoNH.png|thumb|right|300px|A Hutt smoking Marcan herb]]
'''Marcan herb''' was a herb that, when smoked, could be used as a mild euphoric drug. It was sometimes smoked in [[Hookah pipe/Legends|hookah pipes]] by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and was often rolled and smoked in [[Cigarra/Legends|cigarra]] wrapping by humanoids. It had a distinct odor.
